CV-880 Safety Instructions
For your safety, know the quickest way out of this plane. Know where the
nearest exit is, how to open them and how to safely leave the airplane in
case of an emergency. This booklet carefully explains in illustrated detail
exactly what to do in case an emergency exit is necessary, so read it
carefully and thoroughly.
EVACUATION SLIDE
For rapid escape from the aircraft to the ground, a special slide is in-
stalled at each of the four cabin door exits. The TAGG crew knows how
to use the slides. Please follow their instructions.
EMERGENCY EXITS
Door and window exits are clearly labeled. There are two main doors and
two galley service doors. Window exits are in the middle of the cabin
leading onto the wings. Remove handle cover, grasp handle and pull
toward you. The entire window unit will come loose. AN ESCAPE ROPE
is located in the upper sill of the exit for use in leaving aircraft.

IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LANDING please follow these instructions:
1. Put out lighted cigarette, loosen tie and collar, and remove shoes and eye glasses.
2. Take fountain pens and any pointed objects out of your pockets.
3. Move the seat to the upright position. Put a folded blanket over your abdomen and fasten your seat
belt. Sit in the position shown in the drawing and remain in your seat in this position until the plane
comes to a stop after landing.
4. After the plane stops, leave by the door or emergency exit nearest you.
